definitions.explanation: Having an irresistible charm or appeal that draws people in. Used to describe people, voices, scenery, or qualities that captivate through beauty, mystery, or allure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{魅惑的|みわくてき}な⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧だ。
{魅惑的|みわくてき}な⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聞|き}き{入|い}ってしまった。
examples.english: I found myself absorbed in her enchanting voice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ→夕暮れ：07682_yuugure⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{魅惑的|みわくてき}な⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まり→染まる：04254_somaru⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}めて→止める：00678_tomeru⟧{見|み}とれて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The sea at dusk was dyed in enchanting colors, and everyone stopped to gaze at it.

notes:
A na-adjective formed from ⟦{魅惑|みわく}→魅惑：27014_miwaku⟧ (fascination; enchantment) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧. Carries a strong sense of irresistible attraction — something that draws you in almost against your will. The word has a somewhat literary or elevated register compared to simply saying ⟦{魅力的|みりょくてき}→魅力的：04799_miryokuteki⟧な.

Often used in descriptions of people's physical or personal charm, artistic works, and natural beauty. Can carry a slightly sensual undertone when describing people.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {魅惑的|みわくてき}な⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧: captivating smile
- {魅惑的|みわくてき}な⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: enchanting voice
- {魅惑的|みわくてき}な{眼差|まなざ}し: alluring gaze
- {魅惑的|みわくてき}な⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧: bewitching fragrance
- {魅惑的|みわくてき}な⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧: fascinating world

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{魅力的|みりょくてき}→魅力的：04799_miryokuteki⟧な: attractive; charming — more general and neutral, commonly used in everyday speech
- ⟦{妖艶|ようえん}→妖艶：17761_youen⟧な: bewitchingly beautiful — stronger, more sensual and literary
- {蠱惑的|こわくてき}な: bewitching — rare and literary, implies a dangerous or supernatural allure
